In this temporary position, you will play a key role in coordinating outbound logistics activities across Europe and ensuring timely and accurate deliveries to customers. This is an excellent opportunity for a logistics professional who enjoys working in a dynamic international environment and has experience with ERP systems, preferably Oracle. Wie zoeken we? Monitoringshipment progress and proactively communicating updates to internal stakeholders and customers. Supporting Return Material Authorization (RMA) activities. Processing logistics transactions in the ERP system, including receiving, shipping, inventory movements, and material transfers. Maintaining high standards of data accuracy and operational excellence. Contributing to the continuous improvement of logistics and supply chain processes.

Are you looking for a logistics position within an innovative high-tech environment? Do you enjoy working in a structured and modern workplace where logistics and technology come together? Then this opportunity as a High-Tech Logistics Operator could be the perfect fit for you. What’s your job about? As a High-Tech Logistics Operator, you play an important role in ensuring the smooth flow of materials and products throughout the organization. Your work directly supports production processes and helps maintain operational efficiency. Your responsibilities include: Packing and preparing products for shipment. Processing and preparing outgoing orders. Transporting materials and goods within the warehouse and production areas. Working with logistics systems such as SAP. This role goes beyond traditional warehouse activities. You are an essential link between logistics and production, helping to ensure that operations run efficiently and without interruptions. Certificates such as EPT, forklift, or reach truck are considered a plus. What do you get in return? A gross salary of €19.17 per hour, including shift allowance. Travel allowance. A modern, clean, and high-tech working environment. Opportunities for personal development and career growth. A dynamic and motivated international team. Pension scheme participation. Holiday allowance and vacation days in accordance with Dutch regulations. You will join an international high-tech organization specializing in thedevelopment and production of advanced technologies for industries such as industrial automation, energy, and healthcare. The company is known for its innovative culture, modern facilities, and strong focus on quality, collaboration, and employee development. Within this organization, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, develop new skills, and contribute to cutting-edge technologies used around the world.
